title: Prefix sums
objective: Answer "sum from i to j" instantly after one pass of preparation.
simplifies: If the numbers change after P is built, P goes out of date. Structures like Fenwick trees handle changes; they are not covered here.

quiz.prompt: P = [0, 3, 4, 8, 9]. What is the sum of nums[1..3]?

options.explanation: That is P[3] − P[1], which stops before index 3. Use P[4] to include nums[3].
That is the sum from the start. Subtract P[1] to drop nums[0].

quiz.prompt: When are prefix sums worth building?

options.text: Many range-sum questions on data that does not change
options.explanation: Right. One pass to build, then every question is a subtraction.

options.text: A single range sum, asked once
options.explanation: Just add that range up; building P is extra work for one question.

options.text: Data that changes after every question
options.explanation: P would have to be rebuilt each time.
